marc:datafield.marc:subfield: திருநெல்வேலி எழுச்சியும் வ.உ.சி.யும் 1908 | tirunelveeli ezucciyum vaa.vuu.ci.yum 1908

This book explores the significant uprising in Tamil Nadu during India's freedom struggle, focusing on the influential leader V. O. Chidambaram Pillai (V. O. C). Known for challenging British colonial rule by operating a shipping company, V. O. C.'s arrest led to widespread protests in Tirunelveli and Tuticorin, where people took to the streets, organized strikes, and damaged government property. The British government responded forcefully, resulting in several deaths and numerous arrests, and imposed martial law for six months. This book provides a detailed account of the uprising, its background, and its impact, highlighting V. O. C.'s role and the contributions of many ordinary people. Written by A. R. Venkatachalapathy, it combines thorough research with engaging storytelling to bring this pivotal event in Tamil Nadu's history to life.
